metadata.question: Did more forest area burn in Sakha in 2015 than compared to 2021?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare forest area burned in Sakha (a region in Russia) between 2015 and 2021. For burned area analysis, I should use: - Collection: MODIS Burned Area product (MCD64A1) or FireCCI51 - Band: 'BurnDate' or similar burned area classification - Location: Sakha Republic (Yakutia) in Russia - Time periods: 2015 and 2021 full years Strategy: 1. Define Sakha region geometry (approximate polygon) 2. Get burned area collections for 2015 and 2021 3. Count burned pixels in each year 4. Compare the counts to determine which year had more burned area 5. Handle cases where data is missing or invalid I'll use MODIS MCD64A1 collection which has burned area data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Sakha Republic approximate bounds const sakha = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [105, 50], [150, 50], [150, 75], [105, 75], [105, 50] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Burned Area const burned2015 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2015-01-01', '2015-12-31') .filterBounds(sakha); const burned2021 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') .filterBounds(sakha); // Check collection sizes const size2015 = burned2015.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = burned2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Images: ${size2015}, 2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size2015 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create annual burned area composites const burnedMask2015 = burned2015.select('BurnDate').max().gt(0); const burnedMask2021 = burned2021.select('BurnDate').max().gt(0); // Count burned pixels const count2015 = burnedMask2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); const count2021 = burnedMask2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Burned Pixels: ${Math.round(count2015)}`); console.log(`2021 Burned Pixels: ${Math.round(count2021)}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (count2015 === null || count2021 === null || isNaN(count2015) || isNaN(count2021)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (count2015 === 0 && count2021 === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (count2015 > count2021) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
